dialogues.speaker: Bruneau
dialogues.text: Hello. How may I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Bruneau
dialogues.text: This is the Palais Mermonia. This is where all official affairs are handled, and public services are rendered.

dialogues.speaker: Bruneau
dialogues.text: Of course, this is also the abode of Lady Furina, the Hydro Archon.

dialogues.speaker: Bruneau
dialogues.text: Meetings with her are by appointment only, so please follow the rules and refrain from intruding — there will be consequences otherwise.

dialogues.speaker: Bruneau
dialogues.text: This is the Palais Mermonia, where all official affairs are handled and public services are rendered.

dialogues.speaker: Bruneau
dialogues.text: And, of course, it is where Iudex Neuvillette has his office.

dialogues.speaker: Bruneau
dialogues.text: If you have any questions about Fontaine's public affairs, this is where you come to ask. But do follow the rules, please. There will be consequences if you cause any trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can I look around the public area?

dialogues.speaker: Bruneau
dialogues.text: Hmm... Technically, this is an office area, but it is frequented every day by a lot of people who do not work here.

dialogues.speaker: Bruneau
dialogues.text: We don't chase away visitors who abide by the rules. As long as you speak softly and do not disturb our staff, you will be fine.
